body:
Release source-current catalogs on 100 projects / 10k cards / 50k reports improve from 867.2 to 423.1 ms median globally (20 samples each), and from 10.27 to 4.58 ms in the 100-card project (200 samples each). A matched 1,000-card project improves from 75.46 to 33.81 ms median and 77.80 to 34.24 ms p95, with a 51.24 ms maximum. Bounded workers retain sorted results, current source versions, individual validation and partial issues. Invalid names still consume the 50,000-file budget; no cache, protocol or durable-write exception is added.

The full gate passes 265 Rust, 139 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Tags/editor pass in Chromium and WebKit, including the larger real-HTTP catalog, fresh external versions and stale-plan rejection. The original manual app is rebuilt/restarted; all 55 prior source versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved, and trusted HTTPS plus all 33 served assets are verified. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-tag-parallel-reads.md.

Source-size/concurrency profiles, dense Calendar, further history distributions and write pauses remain open. Engine timings exclude transport/browser costs and do not establish physical-device or full release acceptance.

metadata.summary: Verified bounded ordered source reads halve tag catalog latency.
